promises.label: FY27 volume growth 17-18%
promises.quote: We are expecting 17% to 18% volume growth in this current financial year, which will mainly coming from Sanand new facility.
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 10.5-11%
promises.quote: on a conservative side, we can now expect around 11% -- anywhere between 10.5% to 11%.
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Sanand phase 2 by Q4 FY27
promises.quote: So by March 2027, the extra high-voltage power cable production will be there.
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Capex ₹600-700 crore annually
promises.quote: every year, we will be doing around INR600 crores to INR700 crores capital expenditure for next 2 to 3 years continuous.
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Exports ~20% of total sales FY27
promises.quote: taking our export to around approximately 20% of our total sales in the current financial year
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Remain debt-free next 4-5 years
promises.quote: we will be continuing running as a debt-free company for next 4 to 5 years with a top line growth of 20% CAGR
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: QIP ₹385 crore utilized in FY27
promises.quote: the whole INR385 crores unutilized QIP money will be utilized in the current financial year.
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

reported.label: Q4 net sales ₹3,476 crore, +19.27%

reported.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.21%
reported.quote: EBITDA/net sales margin achieved is 12.21% as against 11.6% in the same period previous year.

reported.label: Q4 PAT ₹284.31 crore, +25.5%
reported.quote: Profit after tax in this quarter is INR284.31 crores with a growth in PAT with 25.5%.

reported.label: FY26 net sales ₹11,746 crore, +20.66%
reported.quote: The net sales in FY25-'26 is INR11,746 crores against previous year INR9,735 crores. Growth in the net sales is 20.66%.

reported.label: FY26 EBITDA ₹1,387 crore, margin 11.81%
reported.quote: EBITDA in this financial year -- full financial year is INR1,387 crores, up by 30.56%... EBITDA/net sales margin is 11.81%

reported.label: FY26 PAT ₹918 crore, margin 7.82%
reported.quote: the profit after tax in financial year '25-'26 is INR918 crores with a PAT margin of 7.82%.

reported.label: Order book ₹3,585 crore as of Mar 2026
reported.quote: put together, all order book is close to INR3,585 crores.

reported.label: FY26 net volume growth 6.21%
